title: Practice: Stepping Side Kick
source: Practice Mode tutorial. The owner's "marching forward side kick", added to the app's Technique Library as Kickboxing › Stepping Side Kick (cues, mistakes, next from there). Karate name tsugi-ashi yoko geri kekomi: the shuffle step (rear foot up to the front foot) into the side thrust kick. Footage: the owner's clip 20 (ring, 2026-11-02), raw-footage/practice/p20.mp4, one shot, three reps at about 0.95, 4.1 and 7.6 s.

props.hookSub: Stepping side kick. Tsugi-ashi yoko geri kekomi. 20 seconds.

cues.text: Shuffle the rear foot up first
cues.label: SHUFFLE
cues.say: Coach: "Back foot up to the front foot. That shuffle is what closes the gap."

cues.label: CHAMBER
cues.say: Coach: "The knee comes up as the step lands, not after it."

cues.text: Thrust the heel, hips behind it
cues.label: HEEL
cues.say: Coach: "Drive the heel through and push the hips in behind it."

watch.label: THE STEP
watch.say: Coach: "Kick early and you're off balance with no reach. Land the shuffle, then fire."
